changeSet.author: enterprise
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO mkt_opportunity (org_id, match_id, interest, state, info_request, decline_reason, decline_note, last_response_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT r.org_id, m.id, CASE WHEN r.status = 'DECLINED' THEN 'NOT_INTERESTED' ELSE 'NO_RESPONSE' END, CASE WHEN r.status = 'DECLINED' THEN 'DECLINED' ELSE 'NEEDS_INFO' END, CASE WHEN r.status = 'AWAITING_RESPONSE' THEN r.info_request END, CASE WHEN r.status = 'DECLINED' THEN 'OTHER' END, CASE WHEN r.status = 'DECLINED' THEN r.decline_reason END, r.responded_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM cws_opportunity_response r JOIN requirement_match m ON m.org_id = r.org_id AND m.consultant_id = r.consultant_id AND m.requirement_id = r.requirement_id AND m.status = 'ASSIGNED' WHERE r.status IN ('AWAITING_RESPONSE', 'DECLINED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mkt_opportunity o WHERE o.org_id = m.org_id AND o.match_id = m.id)

changeSet.author: enterprise
changeSet.sql: UPDATE mkt_opportunity o JOIN requirement_match m ON m.org_id = o.org_id AND m.id = o.match_id AND m.status = 'ASSIGNED' JOIN cws_opportunity_response r ON r.org_id = m.org_id AND r.consultant_id = m.consultant_id AND r.requirement_id = m.requirement_id SET o.state = 'DECLINED', o.interest = 'NOT_INTERESTED', o.decline_reason = 'OTHER', o.decline_note = r.decline_reason, o.last_response_at = COALESCE(o.last_response_at, r.responded_at) WHERE r.status = 'DECLINED' AND o.state IN ('ASSIGNED', 'VIEWED', 'INTERESTED')

UPDATE mkt_opportunity o JOIN requirement_match m ON m.org_id = o.org_id AND m.id = o.match_id AND m.status = 'ASSIGNED' JOIN cws_opportunity_response r ON r.org_id = m.org_id AND r.consultant_id = m.consultant_id AND r.requirement_id = m.requirement_id SET o.state = 'NEEDS_INFO', o.info_request = r.info_request, o.last_response_at = COALESCE(o.last_response_at, r.responded_at) WHERE r.status = 'AWAITING_RESPONSE' AND r.info_request IS NOT NULL AND o.state IN ('ASSIGNED', 'VIEWED', 'INTERESTED')
